task: Build trusted full-context Story-aware Prompt assembly and bind its content-addressed envelope to signed review evidence and eligibility gates.
outcome: Running agent_prompt --role=lattice-review-quality --storyId=B-dd81 --format=json prints a deterministic full Prompt Envelope ID tied to the current HEAD and Story facts; replaying it for another HEAD, round, or ReviewRun prints a stable rejection, and compatibility-only evidence leaves REVIEW/quorum readiness blocked.
facts: Story 1 already provides strict canonical JSON, domain-separated digests, PromptEnvelope types, measurement algorithms, and a frozen 16-role lifecycle registry.
agent_prompt currently accepts only role and returns the package role body byte-for-byte.
ReviewRun is the existing signed authority for reviewRunId, lane, round, HEAD, material/storyFiles hashes, scope and workspace.
ReviewPass currently binds ReviewRun indirectly through reviewRunId.
usage-ledger mintRetryAttempt preserves ledgerCallId and creates a fresh attemptId; Envelope must not own those fields.
retired lattice-review-channel remains registered as a REVIEW lane and needs shared evidence eligibility filtering.
constraints: Full context only; incremental selection, A/B replay and budget policy remain excluded.
No-Story agent_prompt output and all 16 protected Prompt bodies must remain byte-identical.
The main Agent cannot supply context payloads, envelope IDs, hashes, contextMode, round or ReviewRun bindings.
New gate evidence must be signed, content-addressed, current and mechanically verified; legacy compatibility is bounded to existing full-context records.
Prompt/process facts require registry plus verifier updates.
Provider calls and hidden wrapper claims remain unavailable and must not be fabricated.
